name: cloudflare-os
description: Agent workspace built on Cloudflare Workers for creating documents, building apps, and running agents with your company’s context and systems.
one_liner: An internal company AI workspace — chat with agents that know your company's systems, and let non-technical staff safely build small apps.
buyer: An IT/ops leader at a 50-500 person company who wants an internal ChatGPT-like tool but safely connected to company data and systems.
business_use_cases: An ops team deploys it so non-engineers can build simple internal apps (dashboards, trackers) without IT tickets.
A sales team uses the built-in slide-deck generator to prep customer meeting decks in minutes.
A security team uses the 'Gatekeepers' guardrails to let staff experiment with AI without risking data leaks.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid deployment, branding ('YourCompany OS') and integration consulting for mid-size companies.
Run a managed-hosting version so companies don't need their own Cloudflare/DevOps expertise, billed monthly.

steal_this: This weekend, deploy a branded version for one local mid-size business (e.g. a law firm or agency) and sell it as a managed 'Company OS' subscription.
